name: Product catalogue with filters and WhatsApp ordering
purpose: Site v0 has no products, filters or order path.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if a run produces a JavaScript error or horizontal overflow at 360px twice in a row, or if spend reaches 35.

outputs: category, size and price filter controls
completion_check: 10 cards show exact names and prices in groups of 3/3/2/2; category buttons show only the chosen category; size and price filters combine and narrow by supplied sizes; each order button opens wa.me/910000011111 with the product name in the message.

name: Mobile viewport and navigation
purpose: No viewport setting or navigation that works at 360px.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if any nav link points to a missing section id or the nav overflows at 360px twice in a row, or if spend reaches 5.

outputs: responsive navigation with anchor links to existing sections
completion_check: Viewport meta present; nav usable with no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px; every nav link targets an existing section id.

name: Size guide table
purpose: No size guide section exists (F-4, item 4).

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the table values differ from the supplied chest sizes, or a JavaScript error or horizontal overflow at 360px appears twice in a row, or spend reaches 10.

outputs: section id size-guide with a heading and a 6-row table
completion_check: Section #size-guide exists and its table shows exactly XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42 in inches, with no overflow at 360px and 1280px.

name: Visit section: address, timings, shop phone
purpose: Address, timings and shop phone appear nowhere on the page (F-5, item 5).

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if address, timings or phone differ from the supplied text, or overflow at 360px appears twice in a row, or spend reaches 10.

outputs: section id visit with address, timings and phone link
completion_check: Section #visit shows 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005; 11am to 9pm Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday; and +91 00000 22222, with no overflow at 360px and 1280px.
